edits.old: Then the daily jobs start for business date 2026-11-30
edits.new:
Then the daily jobs start for business date 2026-11-30

  Scenario: AC19 A batch completes one minute before the expected-by time (X5)
    Given the batch row for DP01 for business date 2026-11-30 completes at 07:59
    When the freshness step runs at 08:00
    Then the system does not flag DP01 stale

  Scenario: AC20 One source of a multi-source product is late (X7)
    Given a multi-source data product is fed by sources CCMS and SVAF
    Given CCMS has a COMPLETED batch for business date 2026-11-27
    Given SVAF has COMPLETED batches only up to business date 2026-11-20
    When the freshness step runs
    Then the product carries business date 2026-11-20
    Then the product is flagged stale
    Then AceDataLate names SVAF as the late source

  Scenario: AC21 A source that the day's jobs do not read is late (X8)
    Given a source that the daily jobs for business date 2026-11-30 do not read has no COMPLETED batch for that date
    When the completeness gate runs
    Then the gate returns COMPLETE
    Then only the products that read that source are flagged stale

  Scenario: AC22 A role without the right reads the stamps (X9)
    Given role RW-REFADM does not hold the right to read the freshness stamps
    When role RW-REFADM calls GET /data-products/freshness
    Then the call is refused with 403 and MSG-P4-002

  Scenario: AC23 The provided operations answer 401, 403 and 404
    Given GET /data-products/freshness is called without credentials, by a role without the right, and for a data product that does not exist
    When each call is made
    Then the answers are 401, 403 and 404 respectively

  Scenario: AC24 A write is replayed with the same idempotency key
    Given a write request has been accepted under an idempotency key
    When the same write is replayed with the same idempotency key
    Then the earlier answer is returned
    Then no second write is made

  Scenario: AC25 An activity is retried or times out
    Given an activity of AceIngestCheckWorkflow fails with a retryable error or exceeds its timeout
    When the activity is retried or times out
    Then no second AceDataReady or AceDataLate event is published
    Then the previous stamp stays in use

  Scenario: AC26 A status change the model does not allow is refused
    Given a status change of DP01 that the status model does not allow is requested
    When the change is submitted
    Then the change is refused
    Then the stored status of DP01 stays unchanged
